## Overview

Prevent native KV offloading from reusing persisted blocks when the same checkpoint is restarted with a different model configuration. Fixes #56311.

## Claims

- Snapshot the full HF configuration, computation dtype, construction-time `max_model_len`, and runtime quantization overrides before loading or memory auto-fit can change them.
- Include that snapshot in FS/object-store namespaces and the P2P handshake, including native offloading nested inside `MultiConnector`.
- Cover runtime quantization, multimodal settings and real offloading fingerprints in regression tests; document the conservative compatibility boundary.

## Validation

Current head: `ba29c63bbaa130128268b9b65c0a0e4cfd85a38f`, tree `852ce8296e1c0399bb970a383a0c1fb299443203`.

- **492 passed, no skips** across nine connector/offloading suites on Linux. CUDA remained uninitialized throughout the CPU run. The four new quantization/multimodal regressions also have the previously recorded before-fix failures.
- **Six fresh-process A100 model checks passed on this head.** Qwen3-0.6B at revision `c1899de289a04d12100db370d81485cdf75e47ca`, BF16, eager FA2, batch-invariant execution, 48 greedy output tokens and top-20 logprobs. All seven required model files matched their pinned content hashes.
- Applicable hooks on all 16 changed paths, whitespace checks, canonical docs and standalone strict docs already passed on this unchanged head. The rendered feature page has 221 valid in-page links.

| Run | Cached prompt tokens | FS bytes read | Against its clean control |
| --- | ---: | ---: | --- |
| Factor 1, shared cold | 0 | No increment sample | Exact match |
| Factor 1, restart | 1,168 | 133,955,584 | Exact match |
| Factor 2, same directory | 0 | No increment sample | Exact match |
| Factor 2, restart | 1,168 | 133,955,584 | Exact match |

Each shared run matches its own clean control exactly for prompt IDs, generated IDs, every captured logprob entry and cumulative logprob. Configuration namespaces are distinct, and existing cache payloads retain their sizes and hashes. Lazy counters without an increment remain `null` in the raw results.

[Current-head model/CPU results, commands and raw evidence](https://github.com/JiataiWang/vllm/blob/3fa2e165ebc3be80cb072ff870dd45a2b3015d44/contribution-validation/2026-11-01/pr56331/README.md). The new run uses one A100-SXM4-40GB with Python 3.12.16, PyTorch 2.14.0+cu130 and Transformers 5.20.2. Native extensions come from the official precompiled wheel at the merged upstream base `ed1a7307950ab5e6593d25123579ed7ca998b350`; frontend/worker source and library hashes are recorded. This covers TP1 filesystem isolation and restart, without making claims about actual P2P/object-store deployments, model quality or performance.

Hosted CI remains separate from these local results: the [pre-run check](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/actions/runs/40900221328/job/123540136785) stops at contributor eligibility, hosted pre-commit is skipped, and DCO passes. No qualifying label or review request was added.

<details>
<summary>CPU reproduction</summary>

```bash
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES='' PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -rs \
  tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/offloading_connector/test_config.py \
  tests/v1/kv_offload/test_file_mapper.py \
  tests/v1/kv_offload/tiering/test_fs_tier.py \
  tests/v1/kv_offload/tiering/test_obj_tier.py \
  tests/v1/kv_offload/test_factory.py \
  tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/test_handshake_pp_aggregation.py \
  tests/v1/kv_offload/tiering/p2p/test_sessions.py \
  tests/v1/kv_offload/cpu/test_capacity.py \
  tests/v1/kv_offload/tiering/test_tiering_offloading.py
```

</details>

## Details

Checkpoint names and token hashes do not capture all inputs that affect KV. RoPE changes can alter cached keys with the same weights and tokens; Phi3 can select LongRoPE factors using construction-time `max_model_len`. The snapshot is frozen before model loading or memory auto-fit, and includes the full HF config and runtime quantization overrides.

The hash is conservative: output-only fields and context limits can cause cold FS/OBJ namespaces or reject P2P connections even when their KV would otherwise match. `_commit_hash`, `_name_or_path` and `transformers_version` are excluded recursively. Matching fingerprints assume unchanged weights and a compatible runtime; they do not verify checkpoint contents or every kernel choice.

The docs cover cold FS/OBJ migration, retained legacy data without fallback, and rejection of mismatched nonempty P2P fingerprints. Existing acceptance of an absent peer fingerprint is unchanged. KVCR is outside this contract. #55907 separates physical layouts; this change separates model configurations even when layouts match. The earlier overlap check found no other open PR referring to #56311.

- [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Applicable hooks and rendered documentation checks pass on this head.
